candidates.title: Site Engineer
candidates.salary: Attractive remuneration and benefits on offer
candidates.summary: Seeking Site and Project Engineers to deliver complex civil and structural repair projects across Victoria, with career growth and variety
candidates.opening:
SRG Global is an ASX listed diversified infrastructure services company that was born out of Australia's greatest engineering challenge, the Snowy Mountains Hydro-electric Scheme, in 1961.
The Role
We are seeking Site and Project Engineers to join our growing Asset Remediation business in various projects across Victoria.
Opportunity to play a key role in delivering complex maintenance, repair and strengthening projects across Victoria. Working across a diverse range of civil and structural assets, you'll be part of a team delivering practical solutions that extend asset life, improve performance and maintain critical infrastructure.
Key Responsibilities:
 - Deliver and support technically complex repair, strengthening and remediation works across civil, structural, marine and industrial assets
 - Prepare project-specific technical, safety, environmental and quality documentation, includ
key_lines: - Work closely with Project Managers, clients, consultants, subcontractors and site teams to develop practical and innovative constructability solutions
- Degree in Civil or Mechanical Engineering
- Remediation experience will be highly regarded
- Demonstrated experience in effective HSQE management
- Willingness / ability to work in remote locations as may be required

If you have experience in this area and are willing to contribute as part of a high performance team, this is a perfect role for you. SRG Global fully support and promote organic growth within our organisation. This is an opportunity to gain further experience and career progression.
If you would like to join our team please click the "apply" button now.
*By submitting your personal information to SRG Global you consent to such information being collected, held, used and disclosed in accordance with the Privacy Act 1988
